contentHtml:
Stress is a condition or circumstance which can disturb the normal physiological and psychological functioning of individuals. Today with the rapid diversification of human activity we come face to face with numerous causes of stress and the symptoms of anxiety and depression. Stress related issues are very common among working people these days.

Our treatment for stress management requires a minimum of 14-21 days. Along with internal medications this package includes abhyangam, steam bath, sirodhara, thalapothichil, yoga, panchakarma, meditation, and special ayurvedic diet as per the medical condition of the patient.
